title: Nurse refill protocol: requirements for approving a renewal
content:
**Protocol clause — Prescriptions & Renewals.** A renewal is approved only when every requirement of the class is current on the renewal date; otherwise it is put on hold naming the first missing requirement in this order: visit, lab, drug screen, agreement, database check, prior authorization.

### The visit requirement

The renewal date is no later than the tier's visit interval counted from the patient's most recent completed visit with the prescribing department. The interval is counted in calendar months from the visit date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist, and a renewal on that day still qualifies.

The most recent completed visit with the prescribing department is the latest date among the patient's In-Person Appointments recorded as completed in the department of the prescriber and the patient's Virtual Care visits recorded as completed in that department, up to the day of the renewal. The evidence is the system record of that visit — its date, its status and its department — read before the renewal is approved.

### The lab requirement

Where the class has a monitoring lab interval above 0, the date of the last monitoring lab on the prescription is within that many calendar months before the renewal date, counted the same way as the visit interval.

### The remaining requirements

The drug-screen, agreement and database-check requirements are those of the controlled-substance safeguards of the Prescriptions & Renewals line, and the prior-authorization requirement is that of its specialty access rule.

### Prescriber review after a long gap

A renewal whose last fill ran out more than the class's adherence gap for prescriber review ago needs the prescriber's review even where the refill protocol would otherwise apply.

### Boundary cases for the visit interval (hypothetical dates)

| Class and interval | Most recent completed visit | Last qualifying renewal date | First date that does not qualify |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Maintenance Prescription, 12 months | 31 March | 31 March one year later | 1 April one year later |
| Schedule II Controlled Prescription, 3 months | 30 November | 28 February (non-leap year: 30 February does not exist) | 1 March |
| Monitored Maintenance Prescription, 6 months | 15 January | 15 July | 16 July |

### Hold reason when several requirements are missing (hypothetical)

| Visit current | Lab current | Drug screen current | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | no | — | on hold, naming the visit |
| yes | no | — | on hold, naming the lab |
| yes | yes (or no lab interval) | no | on hold, naming the drug screen |
| yes | yes | yes, and every later requirement current | approved |
